basePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create actual polished mascot concept artwork for Cat Code, a creative coding desktop app. Exactly TEN NEW, DISTINCT cat-inspired mascot characters on ONE landscape PNG sheet, in a strict equal 5-column by 2-row grid. One character per cell, fully visible, including ears, paws, garment, tail, with generous clean space on every side. Neutral front or slight three-quarter standing/sitting comparison poses. Smooth shapes, no shaggy/fluffy fur. Appealing recognizable silhouettes and simple repeatable construction suitable for many future action poses and welcome-screen scale. Wide exploration: every character on this sheet must have a fundamentally different silhouette, proportions, face and visual construction, not a common base in new colors/accessories. Cat inspiration can be abstract; realistic anatomy is unnecessary. Light neutral ivory background, very faint equal-cell dividers, no scene or decorative graphics. IDs only in clean small dark sans-serif type at upper left of each cell. NO names, headings, descriptions, words, logos, watermarks, or coding-symbol stamps. Top row IDs left-to-right and then bottom row as specified. Keep all artwork within central 78% width and 76% height of its own cell, leave top margin for ID. Varied considered palettes, including some pink with contrasting colors. Connections to coding should come from structure, visual rhythms, modularity or craft, not repeated glyphs on clothes.
The ORIGINAL batch already covered ordinary round/pear/triangular cats in scarves, overalls, hoodies, capes, utility jackets, oversized mittens/boots, giant spiral/ring tails, oval face masks, bracket/terminal markings, pixelated ears, felt plush toys. Do not repeat those combinations or recolor them. No bunny-long ears. No extra mini-characters. Focus appearance only.
